name: Circle Packing
desc: A poster field of seeded circles grown until they kiss their neighbours, each dot cycling through bloom-and-pop on staggered phases while the limited palette rotates a hue every musical section.

density.doc: circle count — higher packs more, smaller dots (rebuilds packing)

scale.doc: radius multiplier — max overlaps into a solid field

pop.doc: how hard strong bass pops the circles

style.doc: aesthetic — flat poster dot / concentric schematic rings / misregistered CMYK halftone / chiaroscuro spheres

act.doc: dramaturgy — staggered bloom / snap-and-fall pop / sine breathe
